_comment: Central icon map for Korean Vocab Farm V6 Icon Edition (layer V9). New icons live in assets/icons/v6/ (24 PNGs split from the 6x4 sprite sheet + 7 sticker-style SVGs drawn for missing concepts). V9 never edits game logic: it swaps sources created by the V3 art layer (src map) and converts remaining UI emoji text nodes (emoji map). Emoji that are internal data keys (pets, decor, classic bosses, crop stages, garden plots) are NOT listed here — they keep their existing PNG art via V3.

☀️.where: Day button, farm label (CSS handled separately)

⚔️.where: achievement Boss Hunter, HUD Fight Boss button

🌾.where: achievement Garden Master (h1 CSS handled separately)

🌿.where: Boss World root warning (garden plots are skipped)

👑.where: achievement Hangul Master, King phase-2 toast

💎.where: HUD gems chip, achievement Lv 10, toasts

🔥.where: HUD streak chip, achievement 7-day streak, boss fire warnings

🥀.where: Wilted plant status (garden plots are skipped)

source: 24 PNGs: home, farm, barn, backpack, quest, book, grammar, listen, speak, write, boss, attack, defense, health, energy, xp, coin, gem, chest, settings, weather, seeds, water, harvest (256x256, transparent, from sprite sheet image-2.png). 7 SVGs drawn in the same sticker style (white outline): bell, moon, flame, check, lock, question, wilt.

assets/icons/bubble.svg.was: speech bubble (unused in V5, mapped for safety)

assets/icons/chest.svg.was: chest (unused in V5, mapped for safety)

assets/icons/star.svg.was: star (unused in V5, mapped for safety)
